claims.claim: PG&E's Q2 2026 update reported a data-center project pipeline above 12 GW and stated that, with appropriate pricing, each 1 GW of new data-center load could reduce customer monthly bills by 1% or more.

PG&E's Continuous Monitoring Center combines grid sensors, smart-meter data and machine learning; from January 2025 through June 2026 the capabilities avoided 28 potential ignitions and 19.6 million outage minutes according to the company.

factors.name: AI/data-center load growth
factors.basis: A >12 GW pipeline is a material emerging demand signal for utility infrastructure if projects convert under appropriate tariffs.

factors.name: grid intelligence
factors.basis: Sensor and ML deployment has company-reported operational outcomes in ignition and outage avoidance.

risks.risk: Data-center pipeline is not equivalent to contracted energized load; interconnection, generation, transmission, tariff and permitting constraints can reduce conversion.
Wildfire exposure remains a high-materiality operational and financial risk despite mitigation progress.

unknowns.unknown: Conversion timing and firm contractual status of the >12 GW pipeline are not established in the cited release.

claims.claim: PG&E reported Q2 2026 GAAP EPS of $0.33 and non-GAAP core EPS of $0.40, versus $0.24 and $0.31 respectively a year earlier, and reaffirmed full-year core EPS guidance of $1.64-$1.66.

The utility completed 37 miles of undergrounding and 100 miles of strengthened poles/covered powerlines in Q2 and targets more than 1,900 total undergrounded miles and more than 2,000 miles of strengthened/covered lines by end-2027.

factors.name: financial execution
factors.basis: Year-over-year earnings improvement and reaffirmed guidance support current plan execution.

factors.name: wildfire mitigation delivery
factors.basis: Physical undergrounding and covered-line milestones provide measurable execution evidence.

factors.name: regulatory/capital burden
factors.basis: Large infrastructure investment depends on regulatory recovery, financing and customer affordability.

risks.risk: Wildfire Fund expense, regulatory outcomes and financing costs remain material to realized shareholder economics.

unknowns.unknown: Future wildfire frequency/severity and regulatory treatment cannot be inferred from current mitigation milestones.
